scope: read-only descriptive audit of all four validation-selected continuation checkpoints; no training, checkpoint selection or hyperparameter search
checkpoints: seeds2081/2082 x keep_lr/lower_lr, selected by the existing continuation plan; no best-seed filtering
data: same1680 selected training and1080 development-validation examples; test not opened
provenance: verify completed continuation, its source chain/protocols/code/hashes, selected checkpoint metadata and history, parameter JSONL hashes, one-to-one source/condition/label/SNR joins and each selected IQ hash
secondary_tables: focus-family class x SNR x requested bandwidth; descriptive only, sparse cells expected
bin_rule: left-inclusive/right-exclusive; last upper edge inclusive; missing/not-applicable explicit, never imputed
counts: show number of examples, correct, predicted-label counts, unique condition IDs; mark cells with fewer than20 examples as sparse
score: record softmax maximum as uncalibrated model score, not probability; count errors with score>=0.8 descriptively
outputs: one root report for routine review plus full per-example CSV files and checkpoint/metadata hashes; preserve all four model variants
generator_limit: Only actually recorded parameters may be attributed. FSK internal modulation index/pulse/BT draws were not logged by the existing wrapper; list this gap rather than infer numeric values from labels or regenerate silently
interpretation: associations are not isolated causes; nuisance conditions paired across classes, cell counts are not independent trial counts; adaptive development data is not an independent accuracy estimate
decision: identify reproducible error strata across both seeds/branches before proposing a separately planned intervention or generator replay. No automatic training or class removal
classes: all twelve retained, including noise with no signal SNR/bandwidth/offset
